warning: THE TOWN’S MINUTES, STRUCTURED: who attended, votes, decisions, budget items, transfers, public comment and topics, read by a language model from the extracted text. The minutes are the record; every item carries its quote from them, checked verbatim.

votes.motion: Approve the three variances for 26 Ramgren Road, on the condition that the variance request letter be corrected to include actual distances.
votes.quote: on motion by emond and second by fortin, the board approved the three variances

votes.motion: Approve the groundwater offset variance for 23-25 Hollis Road (5 feet to 4 feet).
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by emond and second by watters, the variances were approved.

votes.motion: Approve the variances for 120 Sunset Lane.
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by watters and second by emond, the variances were approved.

votes.motion: Remove the two-bedroom deed restriction at 717 Reservoir Road.
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by fortin and second by emond, the board voted to remove the deed restriction.

votes.motion: Elect Perry Jewell as Vice Chairman, George Emond as Chairman, and Paul Fortin as Secretary, as nominated.
votes.quote: on motion by paul fortin and second by george emond the above were elected.
on motion by emond and seconded by watters, the meeting was adjourned at 8:45 pm.

Votes are recorded as 'all in favor by roll call' with no tally, so outcomes are 'passed'.
